name: Hallow Masquerade
source:
Hallow Masquerade is a Fantasy/Horror visual novel where a sudden Halloween invitation takes you on a romantic adventure with one of five enchanting suitors, but choose your words carefully so your night doesn't end in ruin.

You've been invited to Hallow Masquerade, where Halloween thrills and chills never fade! Five lovely strangers await your hand, but who will you pick to join you in this fantasyland?

You're drawn to what lies beneath their masks, but winning their affection won't be an easy task. This whole party feels like a beautiful dream, but people aren't always as they seem.

You must win the heart of one lovely soul, but do it fast or your head will roll!

[From [url=https://studiosuzumi.itch.io/hallow-masquerade]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《万圣节假面舞会》是一部奇幻恐怖视觉小说。一封突如其来的万圣节邀请，带你与五位迷人的追求者之一展开浪漫冒险；但选词要谨慎，否则夜晚可能以悲剧收场。

你受邀参加《万圣节假面舞会》，那里永不缺少节日的惊喜与惊吓！五位可爱的陌生人等待与你共舞，你会选谁陪你踏入这片奇幻之境？

你被面具下的真实面貌吸引，但要赢得他们的爱并不容易。整个派对美得如梦似幻，可人们并不总是表里如一。

你必须赢得一位可爱之人的芳心，但动作得快，否则就会人头落地！

[来源：[url=https://studiosuzumi.itch.io/hallow-masquerade]Itch.io[/url]]
